title: Nasdaq-100 Index Futures: Intraday Momentum or Reversal?
one_line: In Nasdaq-100 futures, today's intraday returns show both momentum and reversal depending on the signs of yesterday's and last night's returns; last night's return is mainly followed by reversal.

findings.statement: Last night's (overnight) return is mainly associated with intraday reversal.
findings.evidence: Multiple regression of intraday returns on yesterday's and overnight returns (Journal of Investment Management).

findings.statement: Yesterday's return is associated with both momentum and reversal, depending on signs, bull/bear state and Mondays.
findings.evidence: 'A simplistic view of momentum and reversal proves untenable.'

findings.statement: A forecast model is favoured in four intraday periods, suggesting structure in the opening hours.

why.pattern: Overnight overreaction corrected when the regular session opens (liquidity returns).
why.mechanism: Thin overnight trading pushes prices too far; full-session liquidity at the open reverses part of the move.

reported_results.headline: Overnight return → intraday reversal; sign- and day-dependent.

tradable_edge: Fade the overnight move in the first hour of the regular session (see spec overnight_reversal_first_hour_es, which combines this with Cliff, Cooper & Gulen 2008).
angles: Fade the overnight return 09:30→10:30 ET, ES and NQ
Only after large overnight moves (top tercile vs AvgRange)

decay_risk.reason: Old sample; MNQ falsification study found gap-fill fades unprofitable after costs 2021-2025.

data_fit: ES 1-min (ETH + RTH) Dec 2013 → Sep 2026 in clean_ES_master.parquet; NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026. 2024+ is protected in the backtest project.
caveats: Abstract only; no sample period or magnitudes.
